title: Great Salt Lake 2-Hour Guided Minibus Tour from Salt Lake City
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
The easiest, most entertaining guided way to see the Great Salt Lake from Salt Lake City.

The Great Salt Lake is one of Utah’s most famous landmarks, but much of what makes it extraordinary is not obvious from the shoreline. That is where a skilled guide makes the difference. On this 2-hour fully narrated tour, your guide turns a simple lake visit into an entertaining experience with strange science, local history, lake legends, wildlife, salt, storms, and stories most visitors would miss on their own.

Ride to Great Salt Lake State Park in a comfortable air-conditioned minibus with panoramic touring windows and round-trip transportation from Salt Lake City. This tour is especially convenient for downtown visitors who want to see the lake without renting a car or giving up most of the day.

Operated by Salt Lake City’s oldest sightseeing tour company, this is a quick, easy, narrated first look at “America’s Dead Sea,” designed to help you understand what makes the lake unique.
